title: GestureIo
description: The call of the one gesture implementation (typed-contracts-shared-behaviour.md §4.1): a control member and a script of events in, with the surface's settings; the answer out. Every runtime passes these documents as JSON text, so no struct crosses the boundary. The answer lists every moved value as `member` and `value` entries, never a map keyed by a symbol, so a C writer has no dynamic key.

events.description: The script, in time order; a stable sort by `t` is applied.

Rect.title: Rect
Rect.description: A target rectangle in the surface's pixels: where a control, a bar or a handle can be pressed.

Plot.title: Plot
Plot.description: The size of the plot a handle moves in, in pixels: a horizontal drag of the plot's width is the whole frequency travel, a vertical one of its height the whole gain travel.

Member.title: Member
Member.description: One moved value of a control with its own travel: a handle's frequency, gain or Q, or a bar's height. It states its ends, default and scale in the control's own unit.

min.description: The value at the start of the travel.

max.description: The value at the end of the travel.

def.description: The declared default a reset goes to; absent: the control declares none and a reset is refused.

scale.description: The scale of the travel; a log travel is linear in its logarithm.

step.description: The declared step in the control's own unit, on a linear travel; absent: 1% of the travel.

integer.description: The travel lands on integers (a stepped travel).

value.description: The value the gesture starts from; absent: the default, else the minimum.

Bar.title: Bar
Bar.description: One bar of a bar group: its member's travel, the control symbol it moves, and where it can be pressed.

symbol.description: The control symbol the bar moves; the key of its value in the answer.

min.description: The value at the start of the travel.

max.description: The value at the end of the travel.

def.description: The declared default a reset goes to; absent: none.

value.description: The value the gesture starts from.

Control.title: Control
Control.description: A control member as a surface hands it to the gesture run: the widget, its travel and its geometry. A handle carries its three members, a bar group its bars, every other widget its own travel.

widget.description: The widget, a key of the table in gestures.schema.json.

min.description: The value at the start of the travel.

max.description: The value at the end of the travel.

def.description: The declared default a reset goes to.

step.description: The declared step on a linear travel.

value.description: The value the gesture starts from.

readOnly.description: The control is read-only and takes no gesture.

hold.description: The control is a safety control: a tap acts only after the safety hold.

section.description: The panel section the control sits in, for the table's section exceptions.

orientation.description: The direction a fader or slider moves in; absent: vertical.

travelPx.description: The drag distance of the whole travel in pixels; absent: the declared default.

bars.description: The bars of a bar group, left to right.

selected.description: The bar symbol or `handle` that is selected, or null for none.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: One event of a script, in the surface's time: a pointer down, move or up, a wheel notch or an encoder detent, or a key.

id.description: The pointer's id, for down, move and up.

x.description: The pointer's x in the surface's pixels.

y.description: The pointer's y in the surface's pixels.

fine.description: A move made with the fine modifier.

n.description: The notches of a wheel or the detents of an encoder, signed.

coarse.description: A wheel notch or detent with the coarse modifier.

encoder.description: The encoder's number; 3 is the second-parameter encoder.

bar.description: The bar symbol a wheel, detent or key event addresses.

key.description: The key's name, as the DOM names it (ArrowUp, Backspace).

shift.description: The key was pressed with the shift modifier.

SettingTimings.title: SettingTimings
SettingTimings.description: The timings a surface sets over the declared ones; each is a time in milliseconds above zero, and the safety hold is refused below its declared floor.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: A surface's own settings of the gesture run.

paintWithTouch.description: Whether painting is enabled on touch; false is refused, since painting is required on touch.

paintWithMouse.description: Whether painting is enabled with a mouse; absent: off.

Refusal.title: Refusal
Refusal.description: An event the run refused, with the rule that refused it.

code.description: The refusal code, naming the rule.

t.description: The time of the refused event.

why.description: The refusal in words, for a log.

Cancelled.title: Cancelled
Cancelled.description: A press that ended outside its target and so did nothing.

Shown.title: Shown
Shown.description: How a surface shows a gesture's value: from when to when, and where.

until.description: When it goes, after the claim for a step.

clearOfFinger.description: The text is drawn clear of the finger.

drawnFollowsFinger.description: The drawn value follows the pointer while it is down.

readBackReplaces.description: A value read back from the engine replaces the drawn one.

Change.title: Change
Change.description: One member's value after a gesture: the member's name, and its value in the control's own unit.

member.description: The member: `value` for a single control, `freq`, `gain` or `q` of a handle, a bar's symbol.

value.description: The value in the control's own unit.

Gesture.title: Gesture
Gesture.description: One gesture of the run, from its first event to its last.

id.description: The gesture's id, one per undo entry.

word.description: The gesture word, a key of `words` in gestures.schema.json.

input.description: The input that made it, a member of `inputs` in gestures.schema.json.

changes.description: The members it changed, in the order they changed, with their last values.

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description: What a gesture run answers: the value of every member after the script, and each gesture, undo entry, refusal and cancellation.

value.description: Every member's value after the script, in the control's own unit: one entry `value` for a single control, `freq`, `gain` and `q` for a handle, one per bar.

begin.description: When the last gesture began, or null when there was none.

end.description: When the last gesture ended, or null when there was none.

gesture.description: The last gesture, or null when there was none.

gestures.description: Every gesture of the run, in order.

undo.description: The ids of the gestures that changed a value, one undo entry each.

selected.description: The bar symbol or `handle` or `value` that a tap selected, else null.

cancelled.description: The presses that ended outside their target.
